notes.title: Major Update v1.7.101: Controller Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/6ac23d07c9f67e0933779eef9b130b92dc2880ae.jpg[/img]
You know how it happens: first, you want to fix a thing or two in an old game. Next, you find yourself adding a bunch of features that you always wanted to add, because reasons. That's exactly what happened two us: 2 major updates in a row within a month, is that too much? Dr. Katz says 'NO!' 

So, here goes:

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
That's right, it's a thing now! Of course, while True: learn() was designed for good ol' mouse & keyboard, and that's a preferred means of control for most of our team members.

But maybe you're that type of player, who likes to play on PC but prefers devices tailored for gaming instead of those clickety-clackety office tools? Well, we got you!

Plug in your trusted gamepad, and go solve some puzzles! 

Controller support includes full compatibility with XBOX controllers, and all other XInput controllers and PlayStation controllers. Other brands may (and most likely will) work, but that is not guaranteed.

Additionally, controller scheme includes a very cute paw-shaped cursor! And if you find out that it's just not your cup of tea, just put the gamepad aside and return to the traditional means of control seamlessly!

Here's a couple of examples of the new interfaces (can you spot button tooltips?):

[h3]XBOX[/h3]

[h3]PlayStation[/h3]

[h3]Other[/h3]

[h3]Bonus: Virtual keyboard[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/98be7ad19e0172aec3dc8bf50168569dd9641f2f.png[/img]

Other changes this update brings you include:
[list]
[*] Added an option to turn on a visual keyboard (English only)
[*] Links to educational materials updated
[*] Texts update
[*] Bug fixes
[*] UI/UX fixes
[*] Performance optimization
[/list]

We hope you find this new means of controlling your schemes useful! Please share your impressions in the comments or on our very friendly [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] server.

Until we meet again!

notes.title: New Update: 1.1.89
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/4282ee8ea178ac8d19810704be4126d6e70c1dce.jpg[/img]

Wow, what a spring, huh?

We know that learning new stuff is something that we could do, but few of us were really up to doing. Quarantine was in effect, stress levels were skyrocketing and couch seemed like the place to be.

That said, we were very surprised with how many of you were still playing an educational puzzle game about machine learning! We love you fellas, we really do!

Although we were busy with releasing the game on Nintendo Switch, we could never forget about you PC geeks out there! Now, we're saving some new content for the future, but today we are releasing a very cool update. Here's what it brings:

[list]
[*] A lot of code optimization, like, A LOT. Especially when using custom nodes. The game should run way smoother than before!
[*] That also means the game now loads and switches between screens a lot faster
[*] Many minor bugs were eliminated and should never bug you again
[*] For the fans of "ESC" button we have a treat: it's now doing it's escaping stuff on more screens than ever before
[*] For fans of buttons in general: we've added a "Select all" button as an alternative to CTRL+A or dragging your mouse around
[*] Tutorials were also improved
[*] The following community translations were updated: Dutch (by Bwremjoe), Danish (by legenden), Japanese (by yasuoo), Italian (by Harkeidos), Turkish (by Kadir). Thank you fellas for your hard work, you're breathtaking!
[*] Added new community translation: Vietnamese (by GleeOM). You're breathtaking as well!
[*] Official localisations were updated as well. That includes English, Russian and Chinese version. That makes us also somewhat breathtaking (but not like you guys)
[/list]

Is that it? Well, it is... for today! Stay tuned for more updates and exciting news! And, most importantly, stay safe!

As for our new update, it's hot, hot, [b]HOT[/b]. Perhaps. it's the biggest one this summer! Here's what's new:

[*] We've made the graphics more flexible, meaning that it now supports all kinds of display aspect ratio, not just 16:9. It even fits nicely on ultrawide displays. Or at least it's supposed to (let us know if it doesn't)!
[*] You've asked for it more than once and now it's here: self-driving car levels have been reworked! The tutorial was made way more comprehensive;
[*] Gameplay in the aforementioned levels has been smoothened and now is far less confusing
[*] We've also changed some minor interface elements in those same levels
[*] And we've added a warm and fuzzy blanket to your collective chair, in case your summer is as chilly as ours (or maybe you even live live in the Southern hemisphere and it's winter for you anyway)
[*] We've added some new backgrounds for your obscure in-game workplace. Should be more cozy now, goes well with the blanket, too!
[*] We've fixed some teeny-tiny bugs here and there
[/list]

Now, for the really important stuff! Our very own petting zoo is growing in all kinds of senses! Release the cat now looks prouder than ever:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/0dff431a6d477d90d4c8622296541bb293c6d9a3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update: 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/907840debcf57f8e569125b91cd8947cbada5a7d.png[/img]

Drumroll, please, update 1.1 is here!

Cat just got real!

First of all, we wanted to thank each and everyone who has bought the game and spared some time to leave us feedback. Your positive reviews make us shine on the inside and let us know that we’re doing something right.

Your negative reviews are even more valuable, because they let us grow and learn from our mistakes.

Namely, many of you have been pointing out a significant flaw with our custom/DLL nodes. They worked like magic, and not in a good sense, making the game inexplicably easier. It was not obvious how they work, too.

Well, obviously, we didn’t think this through. This part of the game was an artifact from Early Access, it was implemented by request from our hardcore players who didn’t see that side effect as a problem and neither did we.

But if it was breaking the experience for our players, it had to be fixed. We’re sorry that it took us so long, the task was way more difficult to tackle than we’d initially presumed.

And now they’re finally here! [b]New custom nodes[/b], transparent and shiny! Now you can visually see how neural network magic works inside them. They don’t make your schemes work faster unexpectedly anymore! Check them out:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/55bcce05b226802b859b8a5b750d08cb6b2657dd.gif[/img]

Think that’s it? Well, no! Here’s a brief list of changes introduced by this glorious update:

[b]- Custom/DLL nodes 2.0 (so cool we wanted to mention them again)
- Multiple quests redesigned, 2 quests done from scratch
- Oodles of UI tweaks all around the game
- Turkish localization: 98% complete
- Bugs fixed
- Performance optimized
- Main screen redesigned a little bit
- New and cool theme for the main menu: use the promo code MEME to unlock it[/b]

[b]Important notice:[/b] due to significant changes in the mechanics some of your older schemes might not be working anymore. A perfect chance to give them another go and nail them even better!

Let us know what you think! Does the game feel different now? What else would you like to see there? Let’s talk!

[b]BONUS: [/b] Up for some meme drawing? Here's that fancy 2-cats-1-programmer image without wording: https://imgur.com/Ek1UBKS Meme us! Works good as a wallpaper, too

[*] More interactive objects in the character's room
